entries.summary: The standard 3.2 mm glass-on-backsheet curve (HAIL_SOLAR_DEFAULT_3P2_GBS) is refit as a smooth logistic to the IEC 61215 pass and Kiwa PVEL's 2023-2026 hail results (2025 designs counted as one unit each; 2023-2024 percentages at the smallest sample they allow): D50 51.5653 mm, k_per_mm 0.303422 (was 52.696, 0.165912). 12.0% of modules at 45 mm, 38.3% at 50 mm. Fragile and hardened records, selectors, conditioners and value linkage unchanged. docs r9 (option C, a threshold at 1.75 in) was a Hazard-side candidate and was never published. Evidence: Hazard_modeling docs/hazards/hail/implementation/solar/deep/evidence/2026-11-24_damage_band/ (refit_corrected.py); reasoning: Hazard sheet 05 of docs/discussion/hail/conus_grid/2026-11-22_hail_calibration_method/. Owner ruling 24 Nov 2026.
